programs.nameEn: Chinese-taught Graduate Credit Program - Liberal Arts (One Academic Year)
programs.subjectArea: Liberal Arts graduate-level credit study. The page links 2026 master's and doctoral major catalogs only for reference; no exact 2027 major is asserted.
programs.hskRequirement: For master's-level course study: School of International Chinese Language Education requires HSK 6 score 220 plus HSKK Advanced 65; School of Chinese Language and Literature requires HSK 5 score 210; other majors require HSK 5 score 195. For doctoral-level course study: the corresponding thresholds are HSK 6 score 240 plus HSKK Advanced 65, HSK 5 score 210, and HSK 5 score 195. Prior or current Chinese-medium degree study may exempt the certificate.
programs.tuitionText: CNY 29,000 for one academic year; application fee CNY 450.
programs.scholarshipText: The page names Beijing Government Scholarship, Chinese Government Scholarship, International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship and China Studies Program, but does not publish a route-specific award package or 2027 deadline.
programs.applicationNote: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged 18-45, be current master's students or above, and submit the online form, passport, final degree or enrollment certificate, transcript, Chinese-language proof, two recommendation letters and a non-criminal-record certificate. The application fee is CNY 450; partner exchange applicants may receive the published document or fee exemptions.

programs.subjectArea: Intensive Chinese language, preliminary academic preparation, mathematics, physics, HSK preparation and CSCA preparation before progression to an undergraduate major open to international students.
programs.cscaRequirement: The CSCA score report is submitted during the preparatory period. Progression to undergraduate study requires passing both the CSCA Basic Competency Examination for International Students and the preparatory completion examination.

programs.applicationNote: Applicants must be graduates or expected graduates of a Korean high school, or hold an equivalent qualification, and must be under 25. Required materials are the BUCT application form, high-school graduation or expected-graduation certificate, full high-school transcript, high-school student record, passport copy, photographs, study plan and a CSCA score report submitted during the preparatory period. The program does not publish a tuition amount.

programs.nameEn: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship - One-Semester Study (Spring 2027)
programs.nameZh: 重庆师范大学2027年春季国际中文教师奖学金一学期研修生
programs.subjectArea: International Chinese Language Education, Chinese Language and Literature, Chinese History, Chinese Philosophy, Traditional Chinese Medicine or Tai Chi Culture
programs.hskRequirement: International Chinese Language Education, Chinese Language and Literature, Chinese History and Chinese Philosophy require HSK Level 3 score 180 plus an HSKK result. Traditional Chinese Medicine and Tai Chi Culture require an HSK result and prefer HSKK.
programs.tuitionText: Tuition is fully covered by the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship; no self-funded tuition amount is published for this route.
programs.scholarshipText: Registration, tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance; one-semester students receive CNY 2,500/month.
programs.applicationNote: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens, be in good physical and mental health, be aged 16-35 as of September 1, 2026 (up to 45 for in-service Chinese teachers), and submit applications through both the scholarship and university systems.

programs.nameZh: 2027年中文授课博士项目（127个专业组）
programs.subjectArea: 127 programs are published in the official 2027 catalog attachment; exact program rows and program-specific tuition remain CAPTCHA-protected and are not inferred.
programs.hskRequirement: HSK 5 with a score of 210 or above. Native Chinese speakers and applicants whose prior degree was taught in Chinese may provide the published exemption evidence; some Foreign Languages/Economics routes impose additional catalog-specific requirements.
programs.tuitionText: Exact tuition is published only in the CAPTCHA-protected 2027 program catalog. The accessible guide publishes a CNY 600 application fee, CNY 23-60/person/day accommodation and CNY 800/year medical insurance. Duration is 4 years.
programs.applicationNote: Doctorate applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, have no criminal record and hold the preceding degree; the age limit is under 40. Required materials include the diploma or pre-graduation certificate, notarized transcripts, an 800-word personal statement, two professor/associate-professor recommendations, language evidence, passport, physical examination completed after October 2026, financial support and non-criminal record. A Nankai supervisor acceptance letter is required.

programs.nameZh: 2027年中文授课本科项目（46个专业组）
programs.subjectArea: 46 published undergraduate programs; exact major catalog remains behind the university attachment CAPTCHA
programs.cscaRequirement: All applicants must take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) and submit the score report. Test subjects correspond to the intended major; exact mappings remain in the CAPTCHA-protected official catalog and are not inferred.
programs.hskRequirement: HSK 4 with a score of 180 or above for admission. Students in Chinese-taught programs must obtain HSK 6 with a score of 180 or above before graduation.
programs.tuitionText: CNY 20,000-35,000/year; exact tuition depends on the program catalog. Medical programs last five years; other programs last four years. Application fee CNY 400 is paid at admission, while Chinese Government Scholarship recipients are exempt. Accommodation CNY 23-60/person/day and medical insurance CNY 800/year are separate.
programs.applicationNote: Nankai uses a 1+3 pathway: one foundation academic year followed by three years of major study. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good physical and mental health, normally aged 18-25, hold a senior high-school diploma with strong academic performance, submit the published academic, passport, CSCA, HSK, personal-statement, recommendation, medical, financial and criminal-record documents, and complete document review and interview. Business Economics and Business Administration accept first-choice applications only.
programs.sourceLabel: Nankai University 2027 international undergraduate admissions guide

Insurance covering accidents and medical treatment is mandatory.

programs.nameEn: Pre-University Program - Humanities, Economics and Management Track
programs.nameZh: 上海大学预科项目（人文、经管方向，2027年春季）
programs.subjectArea: Chinese, Professional Chinese, mathematics, optional fundamentals of economics or management, Experience China and Academic Salon. The track provides HSK and CSCA preparation.
programs.hskRequirement: Applicants should hold HSK Level 3 with 180 or above, or demonstrate equivalent Chinese proficiency; applicants below that level may be considered case by case. To apply for Shanghai University undergraduate study after completing the pathway, students must achieve HSK Level 4 or 5 with 180 or above and pass the CSCA test.
programs.cscaRequirement: Students must pass the China Scholastic Competency Assessment before applying to Shanghai University's undergraduate programs after the pathway. The guide does not publish a route-specific CSCA subject mapping or score threshold.
programs.tuitionText: CNY 26,000 for the one-semester program, including tuition, CSCA preparation, HSK mock tests and undergraduate-application guidance; application fee CNY 500 and insurance CNY 400 per semester are separate.
programs.scholarshipText: Students with outstanding academic performance and conduct may apply for scholarships; evaluation criteria are to be published separately.
programs.applicationNote: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged 16-24 with a high-school diploma or equivalent, good physical and mental health, and no criminal record. Required documents include passport, China visa page if currently in China, recent ID photo, a signed 300-500 word study plan, diploma or pre-graduation certificate, full high-school transcript, recent HSK evidence, financial-support statement, no-criminal-record commitment and, for applicants under 18, a guarantee statement. The program begins in March 2027; the exact registration date follows the admission notice.
programs.sourceLabel: Shanghai University Pre-University Program Spring 2027

programs.englishRequirement: Non-native English speakers must provide TOEFL iBT 85 for tests taken before January 21, 2026, TOEFL iBT 4.5 for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026, or IELTS 6.5.
programs.tuitionText: RMB 40,000 per year.
programs.scholarshipText: The Chinese Government Scholarship full award normally covers tuition, stipend, on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, and medical insurance. Tuition scholarships such as the Beijing Government Scholarship may cover full or partial tuition for one academic year and are competitive.
programs.applicationNote: The standard doctoral completion range is three to four years; the direct doctoral route for bachelor's-degree holders is normally four to five years and has additional institution and GPA eligibility rules. Standard doctoral applicants need a master's degree or equivalent in computer science or a related area. Required materials include a personal statement, authenticated degree evidence, academic transcripts and GPA evidence where needed, language proof, two academic recommendations, passport and nationality-status documents. Uploaded documents must be in Chinese or English, or accompanied by notarized Chinese or English translations. Admission uses document review and a comprehensive assessment, generally an interview.

programs.tuitionText: RMB 198,000 for the full two-year program.
programs.scholarshipText: The Chinese Government Scholarship full award covers tuition, on-campus accommodation, medical insurance and a monthly stipend. Tsinghua MBA Program scholarships are awarded from interview performance and comprehensive evaluation and may cover up to full tuition.
programs.applicationNote: Two-year full-time English program on the Beijing campus. Applicants need at least three years of post-graduation work experience after a bachelor's degree, or at least two years after a master's or doctoral degree. Required materials include personal statement, authenticated degree evidence, undergraduate transcript and GPA evidence where needed, two recommendations, passport and nationality-status documents, English resume, English proof, essays, employment information, and a qualifying GMAT/GMAT Focus/GRE result or the Tsinghua MBA Entrance Exam.

programs.nameZh: 清华大学非学位进修生项目（2027年春季）
programs.subjectArea: Short-term coursework or visiting research across participating Tsinghua departments; the official page states that more than 200 English-medium courses are available.
programs.teachingLanguage: Chinese or English, depending on the selected department and course
programs.hskRequirement: Humanities and social-science disciplines require HSK 5 with 210 or above; Modern Chinese requires HSK 5 with 180 or above. Applicants must confirm the teaching language with the relevant department.
programs.englishRequirement: For English-taught courses, applicants from non-native English-speaking countries need TOEFL 90, IELTS 6.5, or an English-proficiency certificate from their current university.
programs.tuitionText: Tuition is department- and subject-specific in the linked Spring 2027 fee schedule; the main official page publishes a CNY 400 non-refundable application fee, CNY 800/year insurance, and accommodation reference prices of CNY 40/bed/day for double rooms or CNY 30/bed/day for triple rooms.
programs.scholarshipText: The program accepts Chinese Government Scholarship Type A and Type B (China Link) routes and the China Studies Program joint-research PhD fellowship. The main page does not publish route-specific 2027 deadlines or award amounts.
programs.applicationNote: Study length ranges from one semester to two years. General visiting students must be aged 18-45 and have completed at least the equivalent of university year two. Senior visiting students must be current PhD students, PhD candidates or PhD holders and are normally no older than 50. Required documents include a study plan, enrollment or prior-degree certificate, latest transcript with 4.0-scale GPA, language proof and passport; senior visitors additionally submit an acceptance letter and two academic references, while arts-and-design applicants submit six photographic design works.
programs.sourceLabel: Tsinghua University 2026/2027 visiting student program with Spring 2027 admission

programs.nameEn: Chinese Language Program in Xi'an (One Academic Year)
programs.nameZh: 西安交通大学2027年汉语进修项目（西安校区，一学年）
programs.tuitionText: RMB 15,000 per academic year; self-funded application fee RMB 500, scholarship application fee RMB 800, and registration fee RMB 400.
programs.subjectArea: Comprehensive Chinese, listening and speaking, reading and writing, HSK preparation, electives and cultural immersion
programs.hskRequirement: No admission HSK threshold is published. Placement covers complete beginners through HSK Level 5+ and assigns elementary, intermediate or advanced classes; a Chinese or English language certificate is submitted only if available.
programs.applicationNote: Applicants must be over 18 and under 45, be in good health and hold a valid foreign ordinary passport. Submit a passport valid for at least six months beyond enrolment, a valid original non-criminal-record certificate, highest diploma in Chinese or English, the completed Foreigner Physical Examination Record and blood-test report, and any available language certificate. On-campus accommodation is required in principle and university insurance is mandatory.
programs.scholarshipText: Applicants may apply separately for the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship; this program page does not publish the award terms or scholarship deadline.
programs.sourceLabel: Xi'an Jiaotong University 2027 Chinese Language Program in Xi'an

programs.tuitionText: CNY 7,000 for the one-semester Spring 2027 Chinese Language and Culture Program; the current official fee table also lists CNY 14,000 for a full academic year. The application fee is CNY 400.
programs.applicationNote: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged 18-60 with high-school-equivalent education, good health and good conduct. Prior Chinese-language students in China need an original completion certificate and at least 90% attendance. Applicants who already earned a degree in China or studied Chinese-language programs in China for more than two years are ineligible. Required materials include academic certificate and transcript, passport, photo, physical examination, non-criminal record, fee receipt and applicable prior-study evidence. Only a one-semester route is offered in Spring 2027.

scholarships.providerName: China Scholarship Council / national dispatching authorities / Dalian University of Technology
scholarships.applicableProgram: Eligible DUT programs and scholar categories available under the applicant's bilateral agreement
scholarships.coverage: The official DUT page states that bilateral awards may be full or partial scholarships and refers applicants to the Chinese Government Scholarship introduction; it does not itemize a monetary benefit schedule on this page.
scholarships.deadlineLabel: Applications are accepted by the relevant national dispatching authority from early November 2026 to early April 2027; the exact deadline varies by authority and is not converted into a fixed date.
scholarships.requirementText: Applicants must obtain nomination eligibility from the dispatching authority. Bachelor applicants must hold a high-school qualification and be no older than 25; master's applicants a bachelor's degree and no older than 35; doctoral applicants a master's degree and no older than 40. The published Chinese thresholds are HSK 4 (180) for science, engineering, economics and management or HSK 5 (180) for humanities, social sciences and philosophy. English routes normally require TOEFL 80, IELTS 5.5 or Duolingo 100, with the stated prior-English-medium and official-language exemptions.
